svg.title: BIST30 Portföy Optimizasyonu
svg.desc: BIST30 Portföy Optimizasyonu: AI and deep-learning portfolio optimisation for BIST 30 stocks. What it does: Return and risk forecasts for every BIST 30 stock over 1, 3, 6 and 12 months. Auto-ARIMA with 51 technical indicators, GARCH(1,1) volatility, Black–Litterman views and an LSTM model for each stock. Monte Carlo portfolio weights for low, medium and high risk profiles. Weekly forecasts with rise probability and dynamic stop-loss, plus a macro stress score from USD/TRY, BIST 100, Brent and the TCMB rate. Flask web app comparing classic MPT with the AI portfolio, tracking accuracy, analysing IPOs and running a user-vs-AI leaderboard. Built with: Python, Flask, TensorFlow / Keras, pmdarima, arch, scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, SciPy, yfinance, Plotly, SQLite, Flask-Login, TCMB EVDS. Graduation thesis.
